hero.title: Where quality *meets craftsmanship*
hero.lede: Roofing, decks, gutters, siding and storm repair for homes around Aiken, with a simple three-step process and clear estimates before work begins.

image.alt: A two-story blue house with a newly installed dark shingle roof under a clear sky

items.title: Roofing
items.text: Installs, repairs and replacements with premium materials, clean finishes and leak protection.

items.title: Storm repair
items.text: Emergency response, damage assessment and full restoration, working with your insurance when needed.

items.title: Decks
items.text: Custom decks in quality wood or composite, built to last.

items.title: Gutters
items.text: Seamless, custom-fit gutters that move water away and resist clogs and corrosion.

items.title: Siding
items.text: Modern, durable siding for curb appeal, insulation and weather protection.

items.title: Home repairs
items.text: From structural fixes to drywall, for storm damage or everyday wear and tear.

items.title: Discovery
items.text: We start with your goals, your space and your budget, so we’re aligned from day one.

items.title: Design
items.text: Plans and material choices you can see, with clear estimates that balance look, function and cost.

items.title: Build
items.text: Our team gets to work, keeps you posted throughout and stays on schedule.

items.q: Do you help after a storm?
items.a: Yes. We respond fast, assess the damage and handle the full restoration, working directly with your insurance company when needed.

items.q: Will I know the cost before you start?
items.a: Yes. The design step gives you material choices and a clear estimate before any work begins.

items.q: Do you build decks in composite?
items.a: Yes, in quality wood or composite.

items.q: Do you do inside work too?
items.a: Yes: kitchens and bathrooms, renovations, additions, custom cabinetry, drywall and mold remediation.
